description: Reported values for a small number of operating variables, one entry per value actually stated in an abstract that was read. This is the sample the sweep range is argued from: the curated parameters.json holds one row per quantity and therefore has no spread to measure. Candidates were found by scripts/mine_ranges.py and then read one by one; an extractor cannot tell a stack temperature from a calcination temperature, so every value here was kept or dropped by hand.
read_on: 2026-09-08; 2026-09-12 gap search; 2026-09-15 unit-coverage search; 2026-09-17 OpenAlex reset-day round; 2026-09-18 thin-sample round
rejected_note: Hits whose sentence turned out to state a different quantity were dropped, not adjusted. The commonest confusions were efficiency figures inside a sentence about recirculation, relative improvements read as absolute efficiencies, and SOFC stack temperatures read as cracker temperatures.

quantities.label: Bottoming cycle thermal efficiency
quantities.note: Thermal or electrical efficiency only. Figures that state a share of total plant output, a relative improvement over another system, or an exergy efficiency were excluded, because mixing those bases is what makes bottoming cycle efficiencies look implausibly high. 2026-09-18: the ammonia-diesel marine engine ORC (8.8-9.3%) takes jacket water as well as exhaust, which is what this study's ORC option is defined to do.
quantities.note_ko: 열효율과 전기효율만 담았다. 전체 출력 대비 비중, 다른 시스템 대비 상대 개선폭, 엑서지 효율은 제외했다. 이 기준들을 섞는 것이 바텀 사이클 효율을 비현실적으로 높아 보이게 만드는 원인이다. 2026-09-16: 증발기 110–155 °C 시험장치·태양열 ORC 값(4.6–10.5 %)은 이 표본에서 뺐다. 이 표본은 엔진·스택 배기처럼 수백 도의 열원을 쓰는 케이스의 스윕 범위를 정하는데, 초저온 ORC(3–7 %)가 섞이면 창이 아래로 끌려 내려간다. 그 값들은 저온 ORC 행에 그대로 인용되어 있다. 2026-09-18: 암모니아-디젤 선박 엔진 ORC(8.8–9.3 %)는 배기와 함께 재킷 냉각수도 쓰는데, 이 연구의 ORC 옵션 정의(재킷 냉각수·소기 공기 포함)와 같다.

abstract_set: 2,786 abstracts, from 14,676 screened records queued across both the included and the held-pending-abstract pools. The earlier sample came from 1,366.
extraction_faults: Widening the cracking context to 'reform' pulled in biomass, plastic, biogas, acetic acid and shale gas reforming. None of those feedstocks is a carrier in this study, and all were rejected.
'SCR' is not only selective catalytic reduction. Four hits came from a staged catalytic reactor for ammonia synthesis, where the same letters and the same units mean something else entirely.
Steam to carbon carries no unit, so the value pattern is a bare number and matches pressures, temperatures and space times in the same sentence. Seventy-nine hits reduced to seven.

'Purity' and 'recovery' were mined as one quantity, which merged the two sides of the S3 trade-off into a single meaningless distribution. They are separate quantities here. The same word also pulls in CO2, CH4, ammonia and methanol purity, all of which were rejected.

An abstract on anode-exhaust gas recirculation says the arrangement gives 'direct current-efficiencies of up to 65%'. The extractor read 65% as a recirculation ratio. It is an efficiency, and it was not used (10.1002/fuce.202100034).

A trilateral flash cycle paper states an ideal efficiency of about 3% below 80 °C without naming in that sentence which cycle it belongs to, so the number was left out and only the qualitative finding was cited (10.3390/e21121197).
Nitrate and nitrite electroreduction papers match every NORR pattern. They reduce a dissolved salt rather than NO gas, and are kept out of the NO sample even though the product is the same.

Low-grade ORC efficiencies (110-155 C evaporator, solar ORC) were first added to the bottoming-cycle sample and then moved out: they belong to a different heat-source class and pulled the sweep window down for exhaust-grade cases.

2026-09-18: pilot share is taken as 100 - ammonia energy share only where ammonia is the primary fuel; a 22% ammonia optimum (10.1016/j.csite.2026.107996) and a 40% ammonia test point were left out because diesel is the main fuel there.

2026-09-18 review: two pilot-share values (10.1080/15567036.2024.2348745, 10.1038/s41598-026-49110-0) had been read from a pilot-injection split ratio; both are 50% by energy. Two slip values that were not post-SCR slip were removed. An electrochemical separation purity was taken out of the S3 purifier sample.
2026-09-18 physics: hydrogen-extraction reactor temperatures (membrane, electrochemical) removed from the fixed-bed MCH and DBT samples; ammonia engine windows limited to ammonia cases.
venue_rule: Values added after 2026-09-10 come from journals in the OpenAlex core set, checked against the public OpenAlex snapshot. Meeting abstracts and venues without an ISSN are held back.

physical_constraints.why: Each window is a literature sample of one variable. These are the physics that join them; a sampled point that breaks one is infeasible however well each coordinate is sourced.

constraints.text_ko: 암모니아 FULL 케이스의 분해 온도는 해당 압력에서 평형 전환율 0.99가 되는 온도보다 높아야 한다 (1 bar 388.3 °C, 3 bar 474.1 °C, 9 bar 583.1 °C). 스윕 하한 230 °C는 촉매 활성 문헌값이지 FULL 설계점이 될 수 없다.

constraints.rule: mch_dehydro_T above the fixed-bed equilibrium temperature for X=0.99 (not yet computed)
evidence: 10.3390/membranes11050326: equilibrium conversion 42% at 573 K (conditions of that study)
constraints.text_ko: MCH FULL 케이스는 고정층 평형이 0.99를 넘는 온도 이상이어야 한다. 250 °C의 평형 전환율은 0.44–0.86이다. 막반응기 값은 표본에서 뺐다. 이 저장소에는 MCH·톨루엔의 검증된 열역학 데이터가 없으므로, 평형 판정은 실행 시 Aspen RGibbs로 한다.
PEM 계열이 받는 메탄올·글리세롤 케이스는 S/C ≥ 1이어야 한다. S/C 0.8이면 완전 전환에서도 건조 기준 CO가 5.3 % 남아 HT-PEM 허용치(2–3 %)를 넘는다.
SOFC 배기로 개질기를 데우는 케이스에서 개질 온도는 스택 온도보다 40 K 이상 낮아야 한다. 두 변수를 독립 표본으로 뽑지 않는다.

constraints.rule: sofc_T >= 600 °C (P008: internal cracking essentially complete above 600 °C; P099 measured 650-750 °C)
constraints.text_ko: 직접 암모니아가 스택에 들어가는 케이스는 스택 온도 600 °C 이상이어야 한다. 스윕 하한(약 500 °C)에서는 스택 안 분해가 끝나지 않는다.
LT-PEM 케이스의 수소 순도는 99.97 % 이상이어야 한다(표본에서 연료전지급으로 명시된 값, 10.1016/j.seppur.2024.130869). 순도는 불순물의 종류를 말하지 않으므로, 암모니아 허용치(P011)는 출처를 찾을 때까지 비워 둔다.
